title: Automation
intro: When something happens, check a condition, then act. Editing writes a new version, so a run already in flight keeps the rules it started under.
name: Name
trigger_help: The moment this automation reacts to.

remove.title: Delete automation
remove.description: “{name}” and its run history are removed. Runs already in flight finish.

action.heading: Actions
action.no_scripts: No script in the scripts folder yet. Put one there and reopen this.
action.no_targets: No notification target exists yet. Create one under Settings, Notifications.
action.at_least_once: Actions run at least once: an automation starts once per event, but an action interrupted after it took effect is tried again.

dry_run.heading: Dry run
dry_run.help: Evaluates this form as it stands, saved or not, against a real package and changes nothing.

pick_or_create: Pick an automation from the list to edit it, or create a new one.
duplicate_hint: Creates a switched-off copy and opens it for editing — switched on, it would act a second time beside the original

history.title: Versions of “{name}”
history.description: Every save keeps the definition before it. Restoring a version saves it again as the newest one; the run history stays.
history.restore_description: The trigger, condition and actions of version {version} become the definition of “{name}” again, saved as a new version. Name and the enabled switch stay as they are.
history.restored: Version {version} is in force again, saved as version {current}.

schedule.heading: Schedule
schedule.help: Read in the service's time zone. A time the service missed by more than two minutes, for example because it was off, is not caught up.
schedule.interval_help: Counted from midnight: 60 runs on the hour, at most 1440 (one day).
schedule.cron_help: Minute hour day month weekday, for example “0 6 * * 1-5” for weekdays at six.
schedule.no_package: A schedule names no package: package actions are not available here.
